description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for fetching details of the authenticated self-user in the Fineract system. It uses annotations to specify API paths, documentation, and conditional component registration. It acts as a wrapper around another service, UserDetailsApiResource, to expose a GET endpoint at /v1/self/userdetails.

classes.name: SelfUserDetailsApiResource
classes.description: A REST controller providing an endpoint for retrieving the authenticated user's details, conditionally loaded based on configuration properties and custom conditions.

methods.name: fetchAuthenticatedUserData
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/v1/self/userdetails', returning the JSON data of the authenticated user, delegating to UserDetailsApiResource.
